caveats: Grid cells were selected from the 0.02-degree dataset grid by inclusive coordinate bounds; the selected 60x60 cells span 55.68-56.86 N and 16.46-17.64 E (no grid point lies exactly on the bounds). 3310 of 3600 cells are sea cells (finite SST on every target day); the remaining 290 are land (mask 0). Baseline pools additionally include the days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05, as required by the +/-5-day windows at the baseline edges. No target or pool day had missing SST for any sea cell (dataset complete over the needed ranges).
